content: संनम् €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To bend, stoop, incline; संनताङ्गी <ls>Ku. 1. 34</ls>; <ls>Bk. 2. 31</ls>; पर्वसु संनता <ls>V. 4. 26</ls>. .²2 To submit or subject oneself to, obey; संनमतामरीणाम् <ls>R. 18. 34</ls>. .²3 To bend down, bow down to. .²4 To make ready, prepare. .²5 To be accomplished. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To contract, bend together. .²2 To cause to bend or stoop. .²3 To make ready, prepare.
